name: Old World (Seven Sovereigns)
description: Pre-genesis era when the Seven Dragons and Dragon King Nibelung ruled the primordial Light Realm.

name: When the Doves Held Branches
description: Arrival of Phanes, creation of the Four Shades, and the golden Unified Human Civilization.

name: War of Funerary Flame
description: The Second Who Came strikes; sky shatters; Enkanomiya sinks; Divine Nails impact Teyvat.

name: Interim Period (Ancient Kingdoms)
description: Rise of Remuria, King Deshret's civilization in Sumeru, and early human settlements.

name: The Archon War (~3,700 – 2,000 YA)
description: Divine war for the Seven Thrones; Morax, Barbatos, Ei/Makoto, and Rukkhadevata prevail.

name: Post-Archon War (~2,000 – 500 YA)
description: Rebellion against Mondstadt Aristocracy, Vennessa founds Knights of Favonius; mortal rule consolidates.

name: The Cataclysm (500 YA)
description: Fall of Khaenri'ah, global Abyssal eruption, death of Archons, and birth of dark beasts.

name: Post-Cataclysm & Traveler's Journey
description: Abyss Order forms, Tatarasuna incident, Traveler awakens and journeys across the Seven Nations.
